stories.title: SEC Opens a Path for Tokenized Stocks After Clarity Act Stalls
stories.summary: The SEC has reportedly cleared a path for tokenized stock trading in the US, per Decrypt. The move follows the stall of the Clarity Act, a crypto market-structure bill, in Congress. Details on the exact mechanism and which firms qualify are still emerging.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized stocks blur the line between traditional securities and crypto markets, so an SEC green light could reshape how equities trade on-chain.
whatToWatch: Which firms receive approval or exemptions first
Whether Congress revives the Clarity Act
How traditional brokers respond to on-chain equity trading
questions: What legal mechanism is the SEC using, given the stalled legislation?
Does this apply broadly or only to specific pilot programs?

sources.title: SEC Clears a Path for Tokenized Stocks After Clarity Act Stumbles

stories.title: Vitalik Buterin Says AI Won't Doom Crypto Security
stories.summary: Ethereum founder Vitalik Buterin said advances in AI will not doom crypto security, according to Decrypt. The comment addresses concern that AI tools could speed up attacks on blockchain systems. The report gives few further details on his reasoning.
stories.whyItMatters: Buterin's views carry weight for Ethereum's technical direction and for how the industry weighs AI-driven security risks.
whatToWatch: Any follow-up detail from Buterin on specific AI-related defenses
questions: What specific AI threats prompted the comment?
Does he propose concrete safeguards, or is this a general reassurance?

stories.title: WisdomTree and MoonPay Partner to Expand Tokenized Money Market Fund Access
stories.summary: Asset manager WisdomTree and payments firm MoonPay are teaming up to expand US access to a tokenized money market fund, per Cointelegraph. The deal pairs WisdomTree's tokenized fund with MoonPay's payment infrastructure. It is the latest move by a traditional asset manager to push tokenized cash-like products to more users.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized money market funds bridge traditional yield products and crypto rails, and wider access could speed stablecoin-adjacent adoption.
whatToWatch: Rollout timeline and eligibility for US users
Whether other asset managers strike similar partnerships
questions: What fees or minimums will apply for retail access?

sources.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund

stories.title: OG.com Cleared by SEC to Offer Single-Stock Futures, Crypto.com CEO Says
stories.summary: Crypto.com's CEO said OG.com has been cleared by the SEC to offer single-stock futures, according to Cointelegraph. If accurate, this would let the platform list futures contracts tied to individual stocks. The report is based on the CEO's statement rather than a direct SEC announcement.
stories.whyItMatters: Single-stock futures on a crypto-linked platform would be another step toward blending equity derivatives with crypto-exchange infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Official SEC confirmation of the clearance
Which stocks and contract terms OG.com plans to list
questions: Has the SEC confirmed this directly, or is it only the CEO's characterization?

sources.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO

stories.title: SEC Grants Temporary Exemption for Tokenized US Stock Trading
stories.summary: The SEC has granted a temporary exemption allowing tokenized trading of US stocks, Cointelegraph reported. The exemption ties into the broader push to bring equities on-chain. Its scope, duration, and eligible participants were not detailed in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: A formal, even temporary, SEC exemption legitimizes tokenized equities as a real trading category rather than a gray-area product.
whatToWatch: Expiration date and renewal prospects for the exemption
Which platforms or issuers use it first
questions: How long does the temporary exemption last?
Does it name specific companies or apply industry-wide?

sources.title: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading

stories.title: Bitcoin Treasury Firms Slow Buying as Paper Losses Linger
stories.summary: Corporate bitcoin treasury firms bought just 5,900 BTC over the past three months, a slowdown amid lingering paper losses, per Cointelegraph. A companion analysis asks whether these firms can outperform BTC itself enough to justify the added risk. Together, the reports suggest treasury-strategy buying has cooled from its earlier pace.
stories.whyItMatters: Corporate bitcoin treasuries have been a major demand source, so a slowdown plus unrealized losses signals weaker conviction from that buyer class.
whatToWatch: Next quarter's treasury purchase totals
Whether paper losses trigger forced selling if BTC weakens further
questions: Which specific firms are pulling back most?
Does treasury-firm outperformance hold up once leverage and risk are factored in?

sources.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?
Bitcoin treasuries buy just 5.9K BTC in three months as paper losses linger

stories.title: S&P Global to Acquire Blockchain Security Firm OpenZeppelin
stories.summary: S&P Global has agreed to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin, according to Cointelegraph. OpenZeppelin is known for smart-contract security tooling and audits used widely across the crypto industry. Deal terms were not disclosed in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: A major traditional financial-data firm buying a leading crypto security auditor signals deeper institutional investment in blockchain infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Deal terms and expected closing timeline
How OpenZeppelin's audit and tooling business integrates with S&P Global
questions: Will OpenZeppelin's open-source tools and audit independence change under S&P ownership?

sources.title: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin

stories.title: Bitcoin's Realized Cap Contracts for the First Time in a Month
stories.summary: Bitcoin's realized capitalization contracted for the first time in a month, with price data pointing to a possible risk level near $71,300, per CryptoSlate. A falling realized cap can indicate capital leaving the network rather than entering it. The report treats this as a signal to watch, not a confirmed breakdown.
stories.whyItMatters: Realized cap is a widely used on-chain gauge of real capital flows, and a contraction can foreshadow price weakness.
whatToWatch: Whether BTC price tests the $71,300 level cited in the report
Whether realized cap resumes growth or keeps contracting
questions: What is driving the outflow — long-term holder selling or shorter-term traders?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s Realized Cap contracts for the first time in a month as BTC price faces a $71,300 risk

stories.title: S&P Global Deepens Crypto Push With OpenZeppelin Acquisition
stories.summary: S&P Global is moving further into crypto with a deal to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin, per Decrypt. The move extends S&P Global's data and ratings business into digital-asset infrastructure. Financial terms were not disclosed in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows a top-tier legacy financial-data company treating crypto security infrastructure as core business, not a side bet.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of deal terms and closing
Whether other legacy finance firms pursue similar crypto security acquisitions
questions: What does S&P Global plan to do with OpenZeppelin's audit business specifically?

stories.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $76.5K as Stocks Rebound From Fed Rate Hike
stories.summary: Bitcoin is coiling near $76,500 as US stocks rebound following a Federal Reserve rate hike, Cointelegraph reported. Bitcoin had absorbed the hike with officials signaling more tightening ahead, after trading below $76,000 while markets discounted odds of a dovish surprise. Together, the reports trace bitcoin's price holding steady through the Fed decision and its aftermath.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's reaction to Fed policy shows how closely it now trades alongside broader risk assets rather than as an independent hedge.
whatToWatch: Whether BTC breaks above or below the $76.5K range
Further comments from Fed officials on additional tightening
questions: Is bitcoin trading as a risk-on asset tied to Fed policy, or will it decouple?

Which stablecoins and partners adopt Arc first
